name: animora
description: Next-Gen anime & movie streaming platform built with React 19, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, AniList GraphQL v2 & Mirror-Box API.

paragraphs: Animora is a state-of-the-art, open-source anime streaming platform engineered with a cinema-grade dark UI/UX inspired by Crunchyroll. It pairs the extensive metadata catalog of AniList GraphQL v2 with the high-speed multi-server streaming and direct CDN download pipeline of the Mirror-Box API, harmonized via deterministic crosswalk ID resolution.
🌐 Live Demo: 📦 GitHub Repository: code9xrs-hub/animora 👤 Author & Creator: Rasel Khan (code9xrs-hub)
features: Mirror-Box Cinema Player: Seamless adaptive iframe playback supporting multiple premium servers (Abyss, FileMoon, Vidmoly, Streamwish, and more).
Zero-Wait Direct CDN Downloads: Download episodes and movies in full quality with single-click direct links.
Cinema Mode: Dedicated "Lights Off" mode, expanded wide theater view, and auto-scrolling to player viewport.
Binge Navigation: Fluid Previous and Next episode triggers with instant stream swapping without page reloads.
Real-Time Countdown with Seconds: Dynamic ticking countdown displaying exact hours, minutes, and seconds until upcoming episodes broadcast live in Japan.
